First release of **Edifier MR Volume**, an unofficial Windows tray app that shows and sets the
hardware volume of Edifier MR studio monitors over Bluetooth LE and follows the knob on the
speaker live.

- The tray icon shows the speaker's own volume (0–30). Click it for a panel with a slider.
- **Auto-open panel** (off by default): turning the knob on the speaker opens the panel for a
  moment, without taking focus.
- **Diagnostics** behind the gear button: connection status, model, firmware, Bluetooth address,
  last error, with Reconnect and Open log.
- Tested on the **MR4.5**. The **MR3** and **MR5** are supported from community protocol captures
  but not yet tested with this app; reports are welcome.
